caveats_on_screen: Slide 6 separates solid (fragment count, location) from interpretation (compost-heated mounds) from unverified (journal).
No date for the eggs is given because the memo gives none.
The compost-heat explanation on slide 5 is a generic mechanism, not a claim about measured temperatures.

caption:
More than 250 titanosaur eggshell fragments have turned up in southernmost Patagonia, evidence of giant dinosaurs nesting at high latitude. The likely trick: mound nests heated by rotting plant matter, like compost. Coverage from 8 September 2026; the journal is not yet verified by our desk.

Source on slide 7.
